thread:
nina: quick proposal: show a micro-inspector when hovering route rows with model, deployed version, 1m latency, tokens/min, and sample-rate. pin to persist.

pete: sounds useful. main constraints: keep payload tiny, batchable, and cacheable.

sam: API sketch: GET /console/inspectors?ids=... returns compact JSON rows: id,m,v,lat_ms,tokens,sr,mode,d_ts,last_eval? short keys to save bytes.

nina: yes. also add cache-control: max-age=5, and client TTL 3s.

pete: rollout: behind feature flag inspector_micro_beta. flag-bot: creating.

flag-bot: created feature flag inspector_micro_beta_2026, default off, internal-only rollout.

sam: telemetry: inspector_batch_fetch, inspector_hover_open, inspector_pin. include batch_size.

nina: accessibility: open on keyboard focus as well.

pete: security: only reveal fields if user has route read permission; redact evals if private.

nina: ok great. pete please PR with batching and compact serializer. will sync with design for the pin UI.

pete: on it. will aim for < 400 bytes per route.
